about: Harnesses under engine/tests for engine/scripts/run-harness.py (docs/manual/agent-workflow.md#하네스-실행기). Steps run in order in one bash process from the repository root with $qa (this folder), $work (fresh result folder), $app (packaged editor), $bin (engine/.artifacts/bin), $probe_dll and $lock (GUI lock). A step with modes runs only when all of them are selected.

steps.run: for p in default ducking; do ./monoon build "$work/projects/$p" release --profile distribution --output "$work/builds-$p"; done
for p in default ducking; do ./monoon build "$work/projects/$p" native-aot --profile distribution --output "$work/builds-$p"; done
for p in default ducking; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" play "$work/builds-$p/AudioLab.app/Contents/MacOS/MoNoonPlayer" "$work/release-$p"; done
for p in default ducking; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" play "$work/builds-$p/NativeAOT/AudioLab.app/Contents/MacOS/MoNoonPlayer" "$work/aot-$p"; done
for p in default ducking; do $lock python3 "$qa/editor.py" $app "$work/projects/$p" $bin/AudioProbe/release/AudioProbe.dll "$work/scene-play-$p"; done

steps.run: for p in distribution development; do ./monoon build "$work/CameraLab" release --profile $p --output "$work/$p"; done
for p in distribution development; do ./monoon build "$work/CameraLab" native-aot --profile $p --output "$work/$p"; done
for p in development distribution; do ./monoon build "$work/CollisionLab" release --profile $p --output "$work/builds"; done
for p in development distribution; do ./monoon build "$work/CollisionLab" native-aot --profile $p --output "$work/builds"; done

harnesses.manual: 기준 에디터와 후보 에디터를 번갈아 재는 성능 측정이다. README의 base=<기준 에디터> 경로를 정해 직접 실행한다.
실제 macOS 키 이벤트로 두 배포본의 시작 시간과 용량을 재는 측정이다. results/phase1-regression 스크립트를 따른다.

steps.run: for s in $scenes; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" prepare samples/ParticleLab "$work/$s/ParticleLab" "$s"; done
for s in $scenes; do ./monoon build "$work/$s/ParticleLab" release --profile distribution --output "$work/$s/builds"; done
for s in $scenes; do ./monoon build "$work/$s/ParticleLab" native-aot --profile distribution --output "$work/$s/builds"; done
for s in $scenes; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" play "$work/$s/builds/ParticleLab.app/Contents/MacOS/MoNoonPlayer" "$work/$s/release" "$s"; done
for s in $scenes; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" play "$work/$s/builds/NativeAOT/ParticleLab.app/Contents/MacOS/MoNoonPlayer" "$work/$s/aot" "$s"; done
for s in $scenes; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" prepare samples/ParticleLab "$work/$s/edit/ParticleLab" "$s"; done
for s in $scenes; do $lock python3 "$qa/verify.py" editor $app "$work/$s/edit/ParticleLab" $bin/ParticlesProbe/release/ParticlesProbe.dll "$work/$s/scene-play" "$s"; done
for s in $scenes; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" compare "$work/$s/scene-play" "$work/$s/release" "$work/$s/aot"; done

harnesses.manual: 창 캡처 33장을 손으로 맞춰 찍는 비교다. results/baked-shaders/README.md의 절차를 따른다.

steps.run: for g in $games; do ./monoon build samples/$g release --profile distribution --output "$work/$g"; done
for g in $games; do ./monoon build samples/$g native-aot --profile distribution --output "$work/$g"; done
for g in $games; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" play $g "$work/$g/$g.app/Contents/MacOS/MoNoonPlayer" "$work/runs/$g/release"; done
for g in $games; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" play $g "$work/$g/NativeAOT/$g.app/Contents/MacOS/MoNoonPlayer" "$work/runs/$g/native-aot"; done
mkdir -p "$work/projects"; for g in $games; do rsync -a --exclude .monoon samples/$g "$work/projects/"; done
for g in $games; do $lock python3 "$qa/editor.py" $g $app "$work/projects/$g" $bin/GameTextProbe/release/GameTextProbe.dll "$work/runs/$g/scene-play"; done
for g in $games; do python3 "$qa/verify.py" compare $g "$work/runs/$g"; done
